operations.body:
Tested in current desktop release, tooltips seem to be working for me on the Next page, except for a weird bug where sometimes hovering over a task name shows that task name in a tooltip, and other times it shows the task ID.
Also, the only tooltips I see are either the task name repeated in the tooltip, or the text "running" when hovering over the project name. Neither of these are useful at all so maybe we don't need tooltips at all on this page, or we need to decide on better ones.
